query:
SELECT l.id, l.amount, l.interestRate, l.numberOfPayments, l.paymentFrequency, l.interestType, l.startDate, l.insuranceAmount
FROM loans l 
LEFT JOIN amortization_schedule a ON l.id = a.loanId 
GROUP BY l.id 
HAVING COUNT(a.id) = 0;
